bodyHtml:
Please join dietitian Kristina Spellman from SetPoint Health for a live webinar demonstrating the new features of our Patient Support Center!  She will be online  tomorrow, July 7th, from 12pm-1pm EST and 5pm-6pm EST.

For PC or Mac, no additional software is needed.  For iPhone, iPad, or Android there is a join.me app that you need to download first.

Happy Losing,

Dr. Curry!
